answer_1.quote: Paraphrase generation is an important task in Natural Language Processing (NLP) that has many applications in other down-stream tasks...

answer_2.quote: We compare different methods using BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR as the most common metrics for automatic evaluation...

answer_4.quote: As there is no appropriate automatic metric for evaluating the diversity and novelty of generated sentences, we use human evaluation to assess the performance of our model qualitatively.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators scored outputs based on grammar and fluency, and consistency and coherency.
